# Available support for the person you care for

2 minute read

Add to read later Print

There are many organisations that can provide supports, services and payments for the person you care for.

Browse a list of organisations to see what payments and services are available.

## Support services available

### National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS)

The NDIS provides funding to eligible people with disability to have greater participation in the community and the economy.

Go to NDIS

### My Aged Care

My Aged Care is the starting point for older people, their families and carers to find information about government-funded aged care services and how to access them.

Go to My Aged Care

### Services Australia

Services Australia delivers government payments and services. Their programs include Medicare, Centrelink, and Child Support.

Go to Services Australia

### Disability Gateway

The Disability Gateway has information and services to help all Australians with disability, their family, friends and carers to find the support they need.

Go to Disability Gateway

### Ask Izzy

Find the help you need, now and nearby. Search over 430,000 support services.

Go to AskIzzy

### Emergency respite

If you become sick or injured and can’t continue to care, Carer Gateway can help to organise emergency respite services to take over while you recover, if a suitable service is available in your local area.

24 hours a day, 7 days a week

Go to Emergency respite page

### Head to Health

The national Head to Health website is a free, confidential service from the Australian Government. It connects you with the help and support you need to keep mentally healthy.

Go to Head to Health

### JobAccess

Access advice, information and funding to support people with disability, employers and service providers.

Go to JobAccess

### The National Disability Abuse and Neglect Hotline

A free independent and confidential service for reporting abuse and neglect of people with disability.

Go to the Hotline

### The Complaints Resolution and Referral Service

A free service for people with disability who are users of Australian Government funded: Disability Employment Services, Australian Disability Enterprises, or Disability Advocacy services.

Go to the Referral service

### Young Carers Network

The Young Carers Network is a nationally coordinated resource to raise young carer awareness, provide information, and direct young carers to appropriate pathways for support.

Go to Young Carers Network

### My Lived iD

Resources and information to meet the needs of people with intellectual disability and their families, carers and health professionals.

Go to My Lived iD

### Younger people in residential aged care (YPIRAC) toolkit

The YPIRAC toolkit provides information and support to help younger people access age-appropriate housing, care and services.

Go to YPIRAC toolkit

Last updated: 18 February 2025
